risk_summary: The excerpt is materially quantified, but it describes declining margins, a substantial Assembly Components deterioration, an Engineered Products loss, goodwill impairment, supply-chain pressures, and higher labor and raw-material costs. Management presents liquidity and cost actions as mitigating factors, while extensive forward-looking disclaimers and broad risk-factor language limit certainty. The apparent SG&A year-label error and truncated segment discussion reduce disclosure reliability.
